user.title: Connect Huawei Health
user.description: Provide the mandatory account information needed to connect to Huawei Health. Before continuing, open the Huawei Health application and allow Health Kit access for your activity, profile, sleep, stress, and body-composition data.

healthkit.title: Huawei Health Health Kit permission
